# coval_alerts (Data Source)

Lists Coval alert summaries visible to the configured API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coval_alerts" "simulated" {
  conversation_source = "SIMULATED"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `conversation_source` (String) Optional conversation-source filter.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID that scopes this lookup. Omit it to use the organization's active default workspace.

### Read-Only

- `alerts` (Attributes List) All matching alert summaries. Use the singular coval_alert data source to retrieve conditions and sensitive channel configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alerts))

<a id="nestedatt--alerts"></a>

Read-Only:
